headline: California Weighs Proposition 40 Wealth Tax Proposal on Billionaires
summary: Representative Ro Khanna advocated for California's Proposition 40 ballot initiative, which proposes taxing the wealth of billionaires rather than relying strictly on income taxes.
why: California represents the largest state economy in the US; potential wealth taxes could trigger tax migration and affect venture capital and startup capital formation.

impacts.name: United States
impacts.why: Wealth tax proposals could influence high-net-worth residency choices and state tax revenue stability.
